FrySharp table.description: Show a list of structs (or maps) as a sortable, filterable table

FrySharp line chart.description: Show numbers as a line chart

FrySharp bar chart.description: Show numbers as a bar chart

FrySharp input.description: Ask the notebook for a line of input (false is the end of input)

FrySharp module.description: Add a Go module: it is downloaded, and cells can import it

FrySharp share a value.description: Offer a value to other languages' cells (#!share --from go name)

FrySharp share from another language.description: Copy a variable of another language's kernel into this cell
